sonnet.problem: The question stops at 'will not the Judge of all the earth do what?' and the baker has to supply the next words of Abraham's line. The baker has not seen those words, so this is a guess at wording, not meaning they can reason out.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The quote "May the Lord not be angry," stops partway through 18:30, which continues "but let me speak further." It has no "…" to show the cut-off.
sonnet.rule: Where it cuts off or skips words, it shows "…", like Jesus says, "Let the little children come to Me…" (Matthew 19:14).

sonnet.problem: The quote "May the Lord not be angry," stops partway through 18:32, which continues "but let me speak once more." It has no "…" to show the cut-off.
sonnet.rule: Where it cuts off or skips words, it shows "…", like Jesus says, "Let the little children come to Me…" (Matthew 19:14).
